description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductOptionDao' that extends a generic DAO interface for ProductOption entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and specific queries related to product options within a merchant store context.

classes.name: ProductOptionDao
classes.description: A Java interface for accessing and manipulating ProductOption entities in the database, including methods for listing, retrieving by name or code, and saving/updating product options.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieve a list of product options associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieve a list of product options matching a given name within a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new or existing ProductOption entity, possibly throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieve a list of read-only product options for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductOption entity by its code within a specific store.
